about_the_game:
Please note: This is an early demo version focused on core mechanics and atmosphere. The game is currently in active development and may not yet include traditional win/loss conditions or full mission structures. We're continuing to expand and refine gameplay systems based on player feedback. This demo is part of an ongoing development process, and we welcome all feedback as we continue to shape the full experience. More structured objectives, mission progression, and full gameplay loops are planned for future builds.

KillCam Blablublas Battle Royale is an immersive single-player experimental FPS demo that explores the intensity of urban combat through a body camera perspective. Designed for players who enjoy tactical, atmospheric experiences, the game focuses on short, high-intensity engagements in detailed urban environments.

Key Features:

  • Body camera-style perspective for a raw and immersive combat experience.

  • Fast, high-stakes encounters that reward precision and quick reflexes.

  • Realistic weapon mechanics with authentic recoil, ballistics, and impactful audio.

  • Highly detailed environments, including apartments, industrial zones, tunnels, and urban streets.

  • Immersive audio design, featuring spatial gunfire, environmental ambience, and minimal HUD.

There are no HUDs, no tutorials, and no handholding — just you, your weapon, and the constant tension of an enemy waiting around every corner.

content_descriptors.notes: This game features frequent combat, high-intensity action, that may not be suitable for all players.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1600
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any, which can handle sound output
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: No

short_description: You’re thrown into the chaos of urban warfare, where every corner hides danger and every mistake is fatal. With a body camera perspective, no HUD, and no second chances, survival depends on your reflexes, precision, and courage.
